item.title: Chase Offers: Spend $600 Through Chase Travel, Get $100 Credit
item.description: Chase has launched a new Chase Offer for Sapphire, Freedom, Ink, and J.P. Morgan Reserve cardholders, offering a $100 statement credit when they spend at least $600 on Chase Travel in a single transaction. item.title: Bank of America Making Big Changes in Preferred Rewards Rebrand
item.description: Bank of America has just announced a massive overhaul of its popular "Preferred Rewards" program. On or about May 26, 2026, the program will officially become BofA Rewards™. The post Bank of America Making Big Changes in Preferred Rewards Rebrand appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: Save $200 on First Hotel Booking Through Capital One Business Travel [Targeted]
item.description: Capital One has a targeted promotion for select business cardholders with a $200 discount on their next hotel booking. item.title: United Making Big Changes to MileagePlus Program Prioritizing Cardholders
